Title: Save Hidden Change of Face Lurker Target Questions for LSJ

Messages.Author: Emmit Svenson
Messages.Body:
One of my minions is in combat. Someone plays Save Face, giving my
minion a mandatory press. Can my minion play a press to cancel that
press, or would that violate the "can't cancel your own presses" rule?

I have two minions. One is blocked and plays Change of Target. Can the
other play Hidden Lurker, or does cancelling the action prevent its
use?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Emmit Svenson wrote:
>
> One of my minions is in combat. Someone plays Save Face, giving my
> minion a mandatory press. Can my minion play a press to cancel that
> press, or would that violate the "can't cancel your own presses" rule?

The latter.

> I have two minions. One is blocked and plays Change of Target. Can the
> other play Hidden Lurker, or does cancelling the action prevent its
> use?

Not having combat between the acting minion and a blocking minion
prevents its use.

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>One of my minions is in combat. Someone plays Save Face, giving my
>minion a mandatory press. Can my minion play a press to cancel that
>press, or would that violate the "can't cancel your own presses" rule?

I would agree that you cannot cancel your own press. From the wording of Save
Face, which states that "the chosen vampire gets a mandatory press", I get the
impression that the designer was well aware of who was getting the press (as
opposed to wording the mandatory press to be like the environmental Trap
press).

>I have two minions. One is blocked and plays Change of Target. Can the
>other play Hidden Lurker, or does cancelling the action prevent its
>use?

No. Hidden Lurker requires a combat (resulting from a block). Change of Target
cancels the combat so you cannot play the Hidden Lurker.

Halcyan 2
